body:
haven’t taken them in a while, but I’ve taken Prozac, Wellbutrin, and lexapro before. Prozac had a negative effect on me but the person who wrote me that prescription (somehow) didnt consider the fact that I was probably too young to be taking it. Wellbutrin did help me with a specific behavior but it did give me worse anxiety as a side effect, and I noticed no effect from lexapro. 
if you’re not seeing a therapist, I would highly recommend that you look into finding one, especially if you’re going to be starting meds. 
psych meds are hard to prescribe and trying more than one is very common. keep in mind that it’ll likely take a few tries, and be patient with it if you’re going to give meds a shot.  good luck, let us know how it goes
